notes.title: Ultra-Wide Support & Enhanced Accessibility is Here!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fort Solis explorers! 👨‍🚀👩‍🚀[/h3]

We’re thrilled to announce a new update that enhances both immersion and accessibility for players navigating the mysteries of [b]Fort Solis[/b]. Your feedback has been invaluable, some promises were made in the first anniversary trailer and we’ve worked hard to bring two more improvements today.

[h3]✨ What’s New?[/h3]

[b]🔹 Ultra-Wide Monitor Support (21:9)[/b]
Experience Fort Solis like never before with full 21:9 aspect ratio support. This update delivers a more cinematic and immersive experience for those with ultra-wide monitors. Dive deeper into the eerie atmosphere and uncover secrets with a broader perspective.

[b]🔹 Left-Handed Keyboard Layout[/b]
We believe every player should feel comfortable exploring the depths of Fort Solis. That’s why we’ve introduced a dedicated keyboard layout specifically for left-handed players.

[b]🔹 Enhanced Right-Handed Keyboard Layout[/b]
To complement the new left-handed layout, we’ve also made improvements to the default right-handed keyboard layout. These changes ensure a smoother, more intuitive gameplay experience for all.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34109/Fort_Solis__Terra_Edition/

💡 [b]Your Feedback Shapes Fort Soli[/b]s

We’re committed to making Fort Solis the best it can be, and your suggestions help us achieve that. Please continue sharing your thoughts in the community forum!

Update your game now and experience these new features firsthand. As always, thank you for your support, and [b]we’ll see you on the surface of Mars[/b]! 🌌

— The Fort Solis Team

notes.title: Fort Solis is now Steam Deck Verified! Ciao Italia!
notes.content:
[h3]We’re thrilled to announce that Fort Solis is now Steam Deck Verified! 🎮🌌[/h3]

Take the gripping narrative and atmospheric journey of Fort Solis with you wherever you go. Whether you're exploring the haunting corridors of the Martian outpost or unraveling its deep mystery, the full experience is now optimized for the Steam Deck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505473/2dd6c25b510519841ac39f34ac6a66515efe6370.png[/img]

[h3]What does Steam Deck Verified mean for you?[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Plug and Play:[/b] Download and jump right in! No messing with settings to get it working.
[*] [b]Built for the Deck:[/b] The controls are designed to work with the Steam Deck, so you can game comfortably.
[*] [b]Optimized Performance:[/b] Fort Solis runs smoothly, delivering an immersive experience without hitches.
[*] [b]Docked or Handheld:[/b] Continue your story anywhere—whether you’re docked for a bigger view or on the move with your handheld setup!
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34109/Fort_Solis__Terra_Edition/

[h3]Also... Ciao Italia! Fort Solis Arrives in Italian![/h3]

That's right, you've asked for it and we listened! We're super excited to announce that Fort Solis is now localized in Italian! We know language barriers can be a bummer when you're trying to immerse yourself in a game, so we wanted to make sure our Italian community could experience the chilling story of Fort Solis in their native language.

So, settle in, and prepare to uncover the mysteries of Mars... in Italian!  Grazie mille for your incredible support! 

See you on Mars 🌑✨


---

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary of Fort Solis!
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Fort Solis Anniversary Celebration! 🎉[/h2]

[b]Dear Fort Solis Community,[/b]

Today marks a special milestone – it’s been an incredible year since the launch of Fort Solis! We couldn’t have reached this point without the support of our amazing community. To celebrate this momentous occasion, we have some exciting announcements and a look back at what made this year unforgettable.

[b]A Year in Review:[/b]

Since the launch of Fort Solis, we’ve embarked on an exhilarating journey filled with intense moments, ups and downs, but thanks to your feedback and support, we have shaped the game into what it is today.

Aside from optimization and bug fixes, we have also added a faster walking option (which was the most requested feature), FSR 3.0 support for AMD cards and GeForce NOW support for Steam version. We've also adjusted game's price for the communities that needed it most! 

But... we are far from over. We are super happy to confirm, that later this year, you can expect more updates based on community requests, so stay tuned for more news about that!

[b]Anniversary DLC:[/b]

To show our appreciation to community - on August 26, 2024 (upcoming Monday) - we will be rolling out a free anniversary DLC bonus pack with some digital goodies, including:

[list]
[*] additional game music (11 tracks)
[*] additional artwork, avatars, animated gifs, backgrounds, wallpapers,
[*] 2 short-stories expanding game's universe (one never published before)
[*] in-game posters
[*] main music theme video clip
[*] and more
[/list]
[b]Anniversary Sale:[/b]

If you or your friends haven’t yet explored the depths of Fort Solis, it will be the perfect time to do so! To celebrate our first anniversary, we will be offering a highest limited-time discount on the base game so far!

Look out for our sale between August 26 and September 9.

In the meantime, for the next 48 hours only, you can grab [b][u]"Fort Solis: Terra Edition" at a 50% discount[/u][/b]!

[b]Join the Celebration:[/b]

We also invite all of you to join us in celebrating this milestone. Share your favorite moments, (screenshots, videos and stories from your adventures) on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wgeGMj26pg]Discord[/url] server.

We’ll be doing a giveaway of Fort Solis keys [url=https://discord.com/invite/wgeGMj26pg]there[/url]! 

And once again, thank you for making Fort Solis an incredible experience. Here’s to many more adventures together on Mars!

See you on the Red Planet!
— Fallen Leaf Team

notes.title: Mini-game challenge inspired by Rubik's Cube!
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Celebrate Erno Rubik's Birthday with the Fort Solis Rubik's Challenge! 🧩[/h2]

Hello Fort Solis Explorers!

We're excited to bring you a special challenge in honor of Erno Rubik's birthday tomorrow, July 13! 

[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ern%C5%91_Rubik]Erno Rubik[/url], the brilliant mind behind the iconic Rubik's Cube, has inspired countless puzzle enthusiasts around the world, and now it's your turn to join the fun within the universe of Fort Solis.

[h2]🧩 About the puzzle in Fort Solis 🧩[/h2]

In Fort Solis, we've integrated a mini-game inspired by the classic Rubik's Cube. This puzzle is not just a test of your skills but also a tribute to the legacy of Erno Rubik. Whether you're a seasoned cube solver or new to the puzzle, our mini-game offers a fun and engaging experience. And of course, our cube is fully operational and 100% solvable — so you can finally prove it's not just your thumbs that are all thumbs!

[previewyoutube=EIJdugbkXio;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]🎮 Fort Solis Rubik's Challenge 🎮[/h2]

[b]Challenge Dates:[/b]
July 12 - July 19

[b]Objective:[/b]
Solve the mini-game puzzle in Fort Solis and prove your puzzle-solving prowess!

[b]How to Participate:[/b]
1. [b]Play[/b]: Launch Fort Solis and navigate to the mini-game inspired by Rubik's cube.
2. [b]Solve[/b]: Complete the mini-game and take a screenshot of your solved cube (please make sure it captures your Steam nick, e.g. using Steam overlay [shift+tab]).
3. [b]Share[/b]: Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wgeGMj26pg]Discord[/url] channel and post your screenshot in the dedicated [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/1187861030861287507/1261251845041557554]#Contest room[/url].

[b]Prizes[/b]:
We have [b]10 fantastic prizes[/b] to give away:
[list][*][b]5x [/b]Fort Solis Original Soundtrack (OST)
[*][b]5x [/b]Fort Solis Artbook[/list]
[b]Winners[/b]: We'll randomly select 10 lucky winners from all valid entries. The winners will be announced on July 20 on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wgeGMj26pg]Discord[/url] server.

This is your chance to celebrate Erno Rubik’s legacy and show off your puzzle-solving skills within the Fort Solis community. Join us in this fun and rewarding challenge!

Good luck, and happy solving!

🔧 [b]Fort Solis Team[/b] 🔧

[hr][/hr]
❓ [b]Why No Achievement?[/b] ❓

We know many of you are wondering why there's no official achievement for solving the mini-game in Fort Solis. 

At Fort Solis, we believe that certain experiences should be enjoyed purely for the fun and challenge they provide, rather than for external rewards. The mini-game inspired by Rubik's Cube is designed to be a relaxing and mentally stimulating activity, encouraging you to take a break from the main storyline and engage in a classic puzzle that tests your problem-solving skills. By not tying an achievement to this mini-game, we aim to foster a sense of personal accomplishment and satisfaction that comes from solving the puzzle on your own terms, without the pressure of chasing achievements.

We hope you find joy and fulfillment in solving the in-game cube, while immersing yourself in the Fort Solis universe.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Walking speed update and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Fort Solis community,[/h1]

[b]Today we have a long awaited and highly requested news for all of you!

We heard your feedback and after some much needed rest we have worked hard on looking at ways to address the walking speed. This is our first step awaiting feedback whilst we look to add more iterations early in the new year.

With the new update, you are now able to increase walking speed by holding down the SHIFT button.

This feature is also planned to be implemented on the Playstation 5 version of the game once we gather enough feedback about it.

We have come a long way since the release and as a small indie studio we would like to express our gratitude for the continuous support and feedback we receive from you. 
It really means a lot to each member of our team.

If you haven't played Fort Solis for a long time, please give it another go as we believe that with the previous bug fixes and optimalization patches, your experience will be much better :)

Should you feel like the game improved, and you enjoyed time spent with it, we would really appreciate leaving a positive review on the Steam store page as it will help to spread our game to a further audience.

Finally, we would like to wish everyone a Happy New Year!

See you again in 2024 with more Fort Solis news ;)[/b]

[h3]List of Patch changes:[/h3]

[list]
[*]Fixed rare issue that saw players locked in the Atrium airlock unable to progress. 

[*]Added fix for Belgium region keyboard support. 

[*]Added new walking speed iteration plus informative tool tip. Currently it increases x1.3. 

[*]Continued optimisation work and Unreal 5 additions.
[/list]

notes.title: Regional pricing adjustment for Turkey and Argentina
notes.content:
[h1][b]Dear Community,[/b][/h1]

[b]recently we've put additional effort to gather as much feedback from you as we can.
All of your insights are invaluable for further actions with our game, and we cannot stress enough how much it mean to us.

We've received a lot of arguments regarding the adjustment of the base price for Argentina and Turkey regions.
Previously, the price for those countries was the same as for e.g. United States.

We are aware that economic conditions are not comparable to those in the U.S. and some other countries, and to make our game more accessible for Turkish and Argentinian players, we decided to reduce it by 18%!

[h2]The price is now set to 20.99$ instead of 24.99$[/h2]

We want to thank you for bringing this issue to our attention, and we hope to gather more feedback from our fantastic community as we work on more things related to Fort Solis![/b]

notes.title: Guide for major issues & questions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505473/44a170671e74a41b37cd5813f46d847db3bd55d8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello Community,[/h3]

[h3]Thank you for supporting Fort Solis. We are sorry to see that some of you are having a bad experience with several issues.

Regarding the main issues that have occurred, here are the solutions/steps we are taking:[/h3]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Performance issues[/h1]
Regarding all the performance issues, we recommend you to update your graphic card drivers if you haven't done it and see if the problem persists. If that's the case, you can send us the logs located in [u][b]%appdata%\Local\Sycamore\Crashes[/b][/u] via this email: [b][u]support@dearvillagers.com[/u][/b] by providing all the hardware details as much as you can. It would help a lot.

[h1]Fatal Error[/h1]
Same as above, some fatal errors can be solved by updating your Nvidia drivers. You should try to get the latest update and it might improve your experience. If not, provide us with your hardware details.

[h1]Gameplay aspect[/h1]
Fort Solis is a game for people who are looking for a short but intense game. The game is designed to be a deep, immersive experience that tells a story. Traditional gameplay mechanics and combat would have affected the narrative elements we worked so hard to preserve. We hope you'll understand this. 

[h1]Ultrawide[/h1]
The ultrawide resolutions won’t be supported. The game has been built around a 16:9 ratio, unfortunately anything outside of that would require all animations and cutscenes to be reworked.

[h1]Key rebind[/h1]
We will look for a solution to address this problem. We are very sorry that this impacted your gameplay experience. The team is already working to solve the identified issues and will communicate on the news hub as soon as a patch is available.

[h1]Steam Deck[/h1]
It's not planned to optimize the experience on the Steam Deck for the moment.

[hr][/hr]
[h3]As we stated in the previous news, Fort Solis is made by a small team of 10 people who are sincerely doing their best to deliver the finest version of the game. We hope that you'll understand about that.

Patches are coming, stay tuned!

Thank you for your support.[/h3]
